title: What a Friend
lyrics_original: What a friend we have in Jesus,
All our sins and griefs to bear!
What a privilege to carry
Everything to God in prayer!
Oh, what peace we often forfeit,
Oh, what needless pain we bear,
All because we do not carry
Everything to God in prayer!
Have we trials and temptations?
Is there trouble anywhere?
We should never be discouraged—
Take it to the Lord in prayer.
Can we find a friend so faithful,
Who will all our sorrows share?
Jesus knows our every weakness;
Take it to the Lord in prayer.
Are we weak and heavy-laden,
Cumbered with a load of care?
Precious Savior, still our refuge—
Take it to the Lord in prayer.
Do thy friends despise, forsake thee?
Take it to the Lord in prayer!
In His arms He’ll take and shield thee,
Thou wilt find a solace there.

bible_verses.telugu: దాసుడు తన యజమానుడు చేయుదానిని ఎరుగడు గనుక ఇక మిమ్మును దాసులని పిలువక స్నేహితులని పిలుచుచున్నాను, ఎందుకనగా నేను నా తండ్రివలన వినిన సంగతులన్నిటిని మీకు తెలియజేసితిని.
bible_verses.english: I no longer call you servants, because a servant does not know his master’s business. Instead, I have called you friends, for everything that I learned from my Father I have made known to you.

bible_verses.telugu: దేనినిగూర్చియు చింతపడకుడి గాని ప్రతి విషయములోను ప్రార్థన విజ్ఞాపనములచేత కృతజ్ఞతాపూర్వకముగా మీ విన్నపములు దేవునికి తెలియజేయుడి.
bible_verses.english: Do not be anxious about anything, but in every situation, by prayer and petition, with thanksgiving, present your requests to God.

bible_verses.telugu: ఆయన మిమ్మునుగూర్చి చింతించుచున్నాడు గనుక మీ చింత యావత్తు ఆయనమీద వేయుడి.
bible_verses.english: Cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you.

devotional.prayer_english: Lord Jesus, thank You for calling me Your friend and inviting me to bring everything to You in prayer. Forgive me for the times I try to carry my anxieties alone instead of resting in Your care. Teach me to turn my worries into conversations with You, trusting that You hear every cry. Fill my heart with Your deep, unshakeable peace today. Amen.
devotional.prayer_original: Lord Jesus, thank You for calling me Your friend and inviting me to bring everything to You in prayer. Forgive me for the times I try to carry my anxieties alone instead of resting in Your care. Teach me to turn my worries into conversations with You, trusting that You hear every cry. Fill my heart with Your deep, unshakeable peace today. Amen.
devotional.reflection_english: Life often presses us with burdens, anxieties, and unexpected trials, making us feel isolated in our struggles. Yet, this timeless hymn reminds us that Jesus invites us into an intimate friendship where no burden is too small or too heavy to share. We don't have to carry the weight of the world alone when the Lord offers us His tender peace through prayer. Today, bring your joys, fears, and weary thoughts to the One who delights in walking beside you.
